postings.title: DevSecOps Engineer
postings.description:
DevSecOps Engineer

About Leaf Space

Leaf Space is a rapidly growing scale-up company and a leading provider of ground segment as-a-service (GSaaS) solutions. Our innovative and proprietary concept is focused on providing satellite and launch vehicle connectivity as-a-service, enabling clients to efficiently manage their assets and fully exploit data. Our GSaaS solutions have been recognized by the market for their efficiency, security, and effectiveness in supporting different applications, from remote sensing to IoT communications.

JOB OVERVIEW

We're building a satellite-based mesh network, and the software and infrastructure behind it — ground segment services, network orchestration, telemetry pipelines, and embedded flight/payload software tooling — need to be shipped fast and run securely. As DevSecOps Engineer you will design, implement and continuously improve the CI/CD, cloud and infrastructure environment, contribute directly to software development across the stack, and build security into every stage rather than bolting it on at the end. This is a hands-on role spanning development, operations, and security for systems that are both mission-critical and subject to strict regulatory obligations.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for ground-segment, network, and embedded software, with automated testing, security scanning, and controlled release gates.

- Contribute to automation tooling and software development supporting the platform and infrastructure.

- Collaborate with embedded software teams to support build toolchains, cross-compilation and integration workflows.

- Manage cloud and on-prem infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible, or equivalent) with reproducible, auditable deployments.

- Operate and secure containerized and orchestrated workloads (Docker, Kubernetes), including image hardening, registry scanning, and runtime security.

- Implement observability — logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting — for reliable, debuggable production systems.

- Harden systems and enforce access control, network segmentation, and least-privilege principles across environments.

- Support compliance and audit readiness against frameworks relevant to critical infrastructure (e.g., NIS2, ISO 27001), contributing to policies, controls, and evidence.

- Contribute to incident response, patch management, and secure configuration baselines.

- Partner with software, network, and mission teams

QUALIFICATIONS AND STUDIES

- Degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

- Roughly 3–6 years in DevOps, SRE, platform, security, or software engineering roles.

REQUIREMENTS

- Tech skills

- Strong Linux knowledge (required) — administration, networking, and development on Linux systems.

- Solid software development skills, with experience writing production code (Python, Go, C/C++, Rust or similar).

- Familiarity with embedded software development environments is considered a plus.

- Strong hands-on skills with CI/CD tooling (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar) and infrastructure as code.

- Solid networking and cloud fundamentals (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

- Practical experience integrating security tooling into pipelines and a genuine security mindset.

- Clear communicator who can work across development, operations, and security.

- Soft skills

- Excellent cross-functional communication skills to interface effectively with engineering teams, suppliers and management.

- Ability to translate ambiguous or evolving requirements into concrete, actionable specifications.

- Rigorous, detail-oriented approach, with a preference for measured/verified data over assumptions, and transparency when prior estimates need correction.

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, still-maturing product environment, iterating on both architecture and hands-on implementation.

- Fluent English (written and spoken) required, given interaction with external international partners.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A flat and collaborative organizational structure

- A fast‑paced and professional environment within a rapidly growing space scale‑up

- Challenging projects with real impact on the global space ecosystem

- An international and diverse workplace

- Comprehensive benefits package, including a welfare platform, meal vouchers, a hybrid work policy supporting work-life balance, and training opportunities

COMPENSATION & TRANSPARENCY:

- Reports to: Head of Engineering

- Career level: P4 – Senior Professional

- Job location: Lomazzo (Como), Italy | Hybrid work model

- Salary range: 45-70K

- Variable compensation: 10% of annual gross salary

- Benefits: Competitive benefits package, including a welfare platform and meal vouchers in Italy, with equivalent local benefits provided where applicable

- Expected start date: 1.12.2026

postings.title: Ground Station Systems Engineer
postings.description:
ABOUT LEAF SPACE

Leaf Space is a leading provider of Ground Station as a Service (GSaaS), enabling satellite operators to communicate with spacecraft through a globally distributed and fully automated ground station network.

Our mission is to simplify access to space communications by delivering reliable, scalable and secure ground segment services to customers worldwide.

JOB OVERVIEW

Leaf Space is looking for a Ground Station Systems Engineer to join our Global Infrastructure team and support the technical operations of our worldwide ground station network.

In this role, you will ensure the reliability, performance and operational readiness of our antenna infrastructure by supporting troubleshooting, maintenance, commissioning and new site deployments. Working closely with Operations, Engineering, AIT and external partners, you will contribute to the continuous improvement of our global ground segment while helping deliver reliable satellite communications services to customers worldwide.

This position combines hands-on engineering, site operations and cross-functional collaboration in a fast-growing international space company.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Ground Segment Engineering

- Troubleshoot antenna and ground station issues, coordinating with service providers, on-site teams and equipment manufacturers.

- Develop and execute troubleshooting and validation procedures for antenna and ground station systems.

- Support maintenance planning and corrective actions to maximise ground station availability.

- Participate in technical investigations and root cause analysis.

- Prepare technical documentation, operational reports and engineering recommendations.

Site Operations

- Act as the technical point of contact for operational issues affecting active sites.

- Coordinate maintenance activities with site hosts and infrastructure providers.

- Monitor infrastructure status, availability and operational performance.

- Maintain accurate documentation of site configurations and infrastructure assets.

Deployment & Commissioning

- Support new ground station deployments and commissioning activities worldwide.

- Participate in site surveys and RF assessments.

- Coordinate installation readiness together with Operations and AIT teams.

- Support antenna dismantling and equipment recovery activities.

Continuous Improvement

- Analyse site performance data and identify improvement opportunities.

- Support reliability and infrastructure hardening initiatives.

- Contribute to engineering best practices and operational procedures.

- Support internal projects related to network expansion and infrastructure optimisation.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree in:

- Telecommunications Engineering

- Electronic Engineering

- Aerospace Engineering

- Electrical Engineering

- or related discipline.

Experience

- Around 3–5 years of experience in:

- Ground Segment Engineering

- Satellite Communications

- RF Systems

- Site Operations

- Antenna Systems

Experience within the space industry is considered an advantage.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

- Ground Station Operations

- Antenna Systems

- Satellite Communications

- Troubleshooting

- RF Fundamentals

- Site Commissioning

- Infrastructure Management

- Technical Documentation

- Root Cause Analysis

- Jira

- Confluence

SOFT SKILLS

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Excellent communication skills in an international environment.

- Ownership mindset and proactive approach.

- Team player with strong cross-functional collaboration skills.

- Availability for domestic and international travel.

NICE TO HAVE

- RF Measurements

- Site Survey Experience

- Spanish language

- Ground Segment architecture

- Satellite Operations

SUCCESS MEASURES

- Ground station availability

- Resolution time for technical issues

- Successful site deployments

- Quality of technical documentation

- Infrastructure reliability improvements

- Customer operational support

WHAT WE OFFER

- Flat and collaborative organisation.

- International and multicultural environment.

- Hybrid working model.

- Professional development and training.

- Welfare platform.

- €8/day meal vouchers.

- Opportunity to work on one of the world's largest commercial Ground Station networks.

COMPENSATION & TRANSPARENCY

- Reports to: Head of Global Infrastructure

- Career Level: P3 – Experienced Professional

- Job Location: Lomazzo (Como), Italy | Hybrid (remote considered within ±4h CET)

- Salary Range: €35,000–40,000

- Benefits: Welfare platform, €8 meal vouchers, hybrid work policy, training opportunities

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Leaf Space is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where diversity is valued and everyone has the opportunity to thrive.

postings.title: Mission Analysis & Flight Dynamics Engineer
postings.description:
Mission Analysis & Flight Dynamics Engineer

About Leaf Space

Leaf Space is a rapidly growing scale-up company and a leading provider of ground segment as-a-service (GSaaS) solutions. Our innovative and proprietary concept is focused on providing satellite and launch vehicle connectivity as-a-service, enabling clients to efficiently manage their assets and fully exploit data. Our GSaaS solutions have been recognized by the market for their efficiency, security, and effectiveness in supporting different applications, from remote sensing to IoT communications.

JOB OVERVIEW

Leaf Space is developing a satellite-based mesh network and needs a Mission Analysis & Flight Dynamics Engineer to convert orbital geometry into operational insight. You'll model how our spacecraft see each other and the ground, quantify network performance throughout the constellation lifecycle, and use that analysis to guide design, deployment, and operations decisions. This hands-on analytical role directly impacts how the network is architected and flown.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Analyze satellite-to-satellite and satellite-to-ground visibilities, contact windows, and link geometries across the constellation.

- Support mission analysis and flight dynamics activities for the Leaf Line service

- Model orbit geometries and dynamics — relative motion, phasing, coverage, revisit, and constellation deployment/maintenance strategies.

- Assess mesh network topology and connectivity over time: routing feasibility, latency, capacity, and resilience as the geometry evolves.

- Analyze ground station network capacity needs and system performance simulations

- Build and maintain simulation and analysis tools; automate recurring studies and produce clear, decision-ready results. Support engineering trade-off studies by providing quantitative mission analysis.

- Work closely with systems engineering, flight dynamics, and operations to translate mission requirements into analysis and back into design trade-offs.

QUALIFICATIONS AND STUDIES

- Degree in aerospace engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or a related field.

- Roughly 3–5 years of relevant experience in mission analysis, flight dynamics, or space systems.

REQUIREMENTS

- Tech skills

- Solid grounding in orbital mechanics: reference frames, propagation, constellation design, and access/visibility analysis.

- Programming for analysis and automation — Python strongly preferred (NumPy, and libraries such as Astropy, Skyfield, poliastro or equivalent).

- Experience with mission analysis tools (e.g., GMAT, STK/Ansys, FreeFlyer, or similar).

- Ability to communicate analysis clearly to engineers and decision-makers.

- Familiarity with satellite communications, link budgets, or network/routing concepts.

- Exposure to operational flight dynamics or ground segment.

- Soft skills

- Excellent cross-functional communication skills to interface effectively with engineering teams, suppliers and management.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to communicate complex analyses clearly.

- Rigorous, detail-oriented approach, with a preference for measured/verified data over assumptions, and transparency when prior estimates need correction.

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, still-maturing product environment, iterating on both architecture and hands-on implementation.

- Fluent English (written and spoken) required, given interaction with external international partners.

WHAT WE OFFER

- A flat and collaborative organizational structure

- A fast‑paced and professional environment within a rapidly growing space scale‑up

- Challenging projects with real impact on the global space ecosystem

- An international and diverse workplace

- Comprehensive benefits package, including a welfare platform, meal vouchers, a hybrid work policy supporting work-life balance, and training opportunities

COMPENSATION & TRANSPARENCY:

- Career level: P3 – Experienced Professional

Senior DSP Engineer (Space Communications)

About Leaf Space

Leaf Space is a rapidly growing scale-up company and a leading provider of ground segment as-a-service (GSaaS) solutions. JOB OVERVIEW

The Senior DSP Engineer for Space-Based Mesh Networks will design, implement and optimize advanced signal-processing and communication algorithms for a distributed constellation of satellites. Working closely with senior technical leaders, you will contribute to the development of resilient, high-performance networking technologies for LEO missions.

This role blends deep DSP expertise with hands‑on FPGA development, space‑system constraints, and cross‑link communication challenges unique to orbital environments.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and implement DSP algorithms for satellite‑to‑satellite and satellite‑to‑ground communication, including modulation/demodulation, channel estimation, equalization, and error‑correction coding

- Develop real‑time signal‑processing pipelines optimized for radiation‑tolerant embedded systems and FPGA‑based accelerators

- Contribute to the design and implementation of cross-link communication protocols

- Model and simulate RF/optical link performance, including Doppler effects, multipath, interference, and orbital dynamics

- Implement DSP modules on FPGAs, including pipelined, parallel, and high‑throughput architectures for low‑latency inter‑satellite links

- Write and maintain HDL code (Verilog, VHDL, SystemVerilog, or Chisel) for custom signal‑processing blocks, PHY‑layer modules, and hardware accelerators

- Collaborate with RF, antenna, networking, and spacecraft systems teams to ensure seamless integration across hardware, firmware, software and network operations

- Perform system‑level analysis including link budgets, timing closure, resource utilization, and power constraints for space‑qualified hardware

- Participate in technical reviews and contribute to engineering decisions
Share knowledge and support junior engineers when appropriate
Contribute to architecture discussions and technology evolution

- Document designs and performance results for internal engineering teams, mission partners, and regulatory bodies

QUALIFICATIONS AND STUDIES

- Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

- 5+ years of experience

- Strong background in digital communications theory, including modulation, coding, synchronization, channel estimation, and PHY‑layer design.

REQUIREMENTS

- Tech skills

- Hands‑on experience with C/C++ or similar language for embedded DSP implementation

- Proficiency in MATLAB, Python (NumPy/SciPy), or similar modeling tools for simulation and prototyping.

- Extensive experience with FPGA development, including synthesis, timing closure, verification, and hardware bring‑up

- Proficiency with HDLs: Verilog, VHDL, SystemVerilog, or Chisel

- Experience with FPGA development; experience with space-qualified or radiation-tolerant platforms is considered a plus.

- Familiarity with RF communication systems; experience with beamforming or optical communications is a plus.

- Ability to optimize algorithms for real‑time constraints, limited power budgets, and harsh space environment

- Ability to work effectively in cross-functional engineering teams.

- Rigorous, detail-oriented approach, with a preference for measured/verified data over assumptions, and transparency when prior estimates need correction.

postings.description:
Senior RF Systems Engineer

About Leaf Space

Leaf Space is a rapidly growing scale-up company and a leading provider of ground segment as-a-service (GSaaS) solutions. Our innovative and proprietary concept is focused on providing satellite and launch vehicle connectivity as-a-service, enabling clients to efficiently manage their assets and fully exploit data. Our GSaaS solutions have been recognized by the market for their efficiency, security, and effectiveness in supporting different applications, from remote sensing to IoT communications.

JOB OVERVIEW

Leaf Space is looking for a Senior RF Systems Engineer to take technical ownership of the communications subsystem for TreeNet, always-on connectivity solution based on an in-orbit federated mesh network. This role sits at the intersection of architecture and hands-on engineering: you will define and evolve the RF/communications architecture (link budgets, MAC/PHY design, waveform and modulation choices, link acquisition strategy, etc.), while also getting into the implementation details and acting as the primary technical interface with the external node designer producer on all things RF and comms. You will serve as the technical reference for RF and communications topics across the TreeNet engineering team.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Own the RF/communications architecture and drive its evolution throughout the product lifecycle.

- Lead link budget engineering across the product's operating scenarios for multiple configurations.

- Design and specify MAC/PHY layer behavior, including channel access strategy.

- Drive availability and performance analyses across orbital scenarios translating orbital mechanics constraints into RF design requirements.

- Act as the primary RF/comms technical counterpart to the external node designer/producer: reviewing their designs, resolving interface and performance issues, and ensuring their implementation matches TreeNet's architectural intent.

- Translate architectural decisions into concrete requirements and specifications consumable by hardware/firmware teams and external partners.

- Support verification and validation activities (test campaigns, simulation-to-hardware correlation) for RF/comms performance claims.

- Contribute to and review technical deliverables: architecture documents, analysis reports, and supporting simulation/analysis code.

- Support development and implementation of DSP algorithms for implementation on FPGAs and processors

- Provide support to regulatory team for licensing matters and coordination.

- Act as the point of contact for relevant subject matter with test partners and early adopters

QUALIFICATIONS AND STUDIES

- MSc (or equivalent) in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Physics, or a closely related field.

- 7+ years of professional experience in RF systems engineering, communications systems, or satellite communications, with demonstrated experience contributing to architecture-level decisions.

- Proven track record with link budget analysis and design for space or other long-range RF systems.

- Experience working directly with external hardware vendors/developers on RF interface and performance requirements.

REQUIREMENTS

Tech skills

- Strong fluency in RF link budget analysis and tradeoff

- Solid understanding of digital communication, spread-spectrum/CDMA systems

- Working knowledge of orbital mechanics as it relates to comms availability

- Proficiency in Python for simulation, link budget modeling, and data analysis; familiarity with reproducible analysis workflows (scripts, version control).

- Ability to produce and maintain rigorous technical documentation (architecture specs, ICDs, requirements, design document, analysis reports) to an engineering-grade standard.

- Hands-on experience with satellite space-to-ground and inter-satellite link (ISL) communication architectures.

- Experience with RF hardware-in-the-loop testing.

- Demonstrated ability working with a systems mindset, factoring in up and downstream effects of design decisions

Soft skills

- Strong ownership of RF/communications design decisions and ability to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to stakeholders.

- Excellent cross-functional communication skills to interface effectively with external node developers/producers, internal hardware/firmware teams, and management.

- Ability to translate ambiguous or evolving requirements into concrete, actionable specifications.

- Rigorous, detail-oriented approach, with a preference for measured/verified data over assumptions, and transparency when prior estimates need correction.

- Comfortable working in a fast-moving, still-maturing product environment, iterating on both architecture and hands-on implementation.

- Fluent English (written and spoken) required, given interaction with external international partners.

Software Network Engineer

About Leaf Space

Leaf Space is a rapidly growing scale-up company and a leading provider of ground segment as-a-service (GSaaS) solutions. Our innovative and proprietary concept is focused on providing satellite and launch vehicle connectivity as-a-service, enabling clients to efficiently manage their assets and fully exploit data. Our GSaaS solutions have been recognized by the market for their efficiency, security, and effectiveness in supporting different applications, from remote sensing to IoT communications.

JOB OVERVIEW

The Software Network Engineer will design, implement, secure, and optimize the networking software stack that enables a resilient, self‑organizing mesh network across a constellation of satellites. You will design and implement routing, SDN‑based control frameworks, link‑management systems, cybersecurity protections, and distributed‑systems capabilities that allow spacecraft to communicate reliably under constantly changing orbital conditions.

This role blends deep networking expertise with systems engineering, real‑time constraints, SDN control‑plane design, and the unique challenges of securing communication in space environments.

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Design and implement networking protocols for inter‑satellite and satellite‑to‑ground communication, including routing, link‑state management, congestion control, and fault‑tolerant data transport.

- Architect and implement SDN‑based networking frameworks, including programmable control‑plane logic for dynamic topology management, policy enforcement, and cross‑link orchestration.

- Design and implement SDN‑based networking frameworks, including programmable control‑plane logic for dynamic topology management, policy enforcement, and cross‑link orchestration.

- Collaborate with RF, DSP, FPGA, and security teams to ensure end‑to‑end secure communication from PHY layer to application layer.

- Contribute to networking architecture decisions, including protocol selection, SDN controller design, interface definitions, and end‑to‑end communication strategy.

QUALIFICATIONS AND STUDIES

- Strong expertise in networking protocols, distributed systems, cross‑layer optimization and software‑defined networking (SDN)

REQUIREMENTS

- Experience with embedded Linux and firmware development.

- Strong understanding of wireless networking, link‑layer behavior, and dynamic topology management.

- Knowledge of LEO/MEO/GEO orbital dynamics and how they affect network topology and link performance.

postings.title: Technical Proposal Engineer
postings.description:
TECHNICAL PROPOSAL ENGINEER

Job Overview

Leaf Space is looking for a Technical Proposal Engineer to support and coordinate the technical development of customer proposals for institutional and commercial customers in the space sector. Acting as the technical focal point during the bid phase, you will translate customer requirements into competitive, technically robust and executable solutions. Working across Engineering, Product, Operations, Sales and Business Development, you will coordinate technical contributions, contribute to the definition of system concepts, assess risks and ensure every proposal balances innovation, feasibility and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

- Analyse RFPs, ITTs, Statements of Work and customer technical requirements to identify relevant opportunities.

- Support the coordination of technical proposal preparation across Engineering, Product and Operations.

- Contribute to the definition of system architectures and technical solutions.

- Develop compliance matrices, technical descriptions and proposal documentation.

- Estimate engineering effort, technical risks and implementation assumptions, ensuring solution feasibility.

- Support pricing activities with technical inputs and resource estimates.

- Participate in customer technical clarification meetings and support technical discussions during contract negotiations.

- Identify proposal risks and mitigation strategies.

- Ensure consistency between technical documentation, pricing and delivery plans.

- Support proposal-to-project handover after contract award and provide technical support during project implementation in coordination with the Project Manager.

- Improve proposal processes, templates and technical knowledge management.

Qualifications & Experience

- Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics or related disciplines

- 4-6 years of experience in Systems Engineering, Proposal Engineering or Pre-Sales Engineering or Technical Bid Support preferably within the aerospace, defence or high-technology sectors. Experience with ESA, EC, ASI or other institutional customers is considered an advantage

Technical Skills

- Systems Engineering

- Proposal Engineering

- Requirements Engineering

- Solution Architecture

- Technical Bid Management

- Requirements Traceability

- Risk Analysis

- Technical Writing

- Cost & Effort Estimation

- Space Systems

- Stakeholder Management

Soft Skills

- Excellent communication and presentation skills.

- Strong analytical and structured problem-solving.

- Ability to coordinate multidisciplinary teams without formal authority.

- Customer-oriented mindset.

- Strong planning and organisational skills.

- Attention to detail and quality.

- Ability to work under tight proposal deadlines.

- Professional proficiency in both English and Italian is required.

What We Offer

- Flat and collaborative organisational structure.

- International and multidisciplinary environment.

- Hybrid working model.

- Professional development and continuous learning opportunities.

- Corporate welfare platform and €8 meal vouchers.

Compensation & Transparency

- Reports to: Public Affairs and Institutional Business Development Manager

- Career Level: P4-Senior Professional

- Job Location: Lomazzo (Como), Italy | Hybrid

- Salary Range: 45,000 - 55,000 EUR gross annual salary

- Variable Compensation: Up to 10% annual bonus

- Benefits: €8 meal vouchers, corporate welfare platform, hybrid work policy and learning opportunities.

- Start Date: as soon as possible

About Leaf Space

Leaf Space is a rapidly growing scale-up company and a leading provider of ground segment as-a-service (GSaaS) solutions. Our innovative and proprietary concept is focused on providing satellite and launch vehicle connectivity as-a-service, enabling clients to efficiently manage their assets and fully exploit data. Our GSaaS solutions have been recognized by the market for their efficiency, security, and effectiveness in supporting different applications, from remote sensing to IoT communications.
